rubric.supported: Cited evidence supports the observation; qualified consistency hypotheses are marked separately and are not causal proof.
rubric.contradicted: A material claim conflicts with cited measurements or arithmetic.
rubric.unsupported_inference: A material clause adds an unmeasured conclusion or lacks supporting cited evidence; this includes claims of absence and semantic payload validity.
